summary: Wisconsin's Commissioner of Insurance gave written notice on September 28, 2023 of a new basic loss ratio of 45% for credit life and new prima facie credit life rates for the three-year period beginning January 1, 2024. Single life: $0.43 per annum per $100 (single premium decreasing), $0.80 (level) and $0.662 per month per $1,000 (outstanding balance). Joint rates are 167% of single.
